editorial:
Imagine getting out of prison only to find out there is a huge bag of cash waiting for you in the dirt. That is exactly the situation you get into with the main character in this flick. He gets back together with his old crew to hunt down money from a DEA deal that went south ten years ago. It feels like a classic treasure hunt but with guns and criminals. You get a gritty, dusty vibe that makes you feel like you are right there in the middle of the chase, while a retired sheriff keeps the pressure on from the sidelines.

What really works here is how the tension builds up as the group starts to turn on each other. The action is punchy and the pacing stays quick so you never get bored. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the acting keeps it grounded. If you are looking for a solid crime thriller, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or maybe rent it on Apple TV if that is easier. If you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head in a big showdown where the greed of the crew finally boils over. After a lot of fighting and betrayal, most of the team ends up dead. You see the truth about who actually knew where the money was hidden all along. In the end, the surviving characters face the consequences of their crimes, and the retired sheriff finally gets the closure he wanted after years of chasing these men.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and stories about betrayal.
